Vote A ASK FOR HER NAME / B SAY NOTHING. JUST WAVE. End card. No NoSwipe mention. No app UI/logos. Joke only on him. Round 2: tags held >=0.8 s, desk form clear, bonk burst on glass, car shot at 24.2, payoff strip 2.25 s, ghost pulse beat in hook a.
